<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable parameters WIDTH and DEPTH.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="WIDTH">Data width of the FIFO.</param>
        <param id="DEPTH">Depth of the FIFO.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <!-- Add your implementation here -->
    <implementation>
        // Dual-port RAM instantiation
        dual_port_RAM #(.DEPTH(DEPTH), .WIDTH(WIDTH)) ram(
            .wclk(wclk),
            .rclk(rclk),
            .wenc(winc & ~wfull),
            .renc(rinc & ~rempty),
            .waddr(waddr_bin),
            .raddr(raddr_bin),
            .wdata(wdata),
            .rdata(rdata)
        );
        // Write Pointer Logic
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] waddr;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] waddr_bin;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr_buff;
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr <= 0;
                waddr_bin <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (winc && !wfull) begin
                    waddr <= waddr + 1;
                    waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr <= {wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)], wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1], wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0]} ^ wptr;
            end
        end
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Read Pointer Synchronizer Logic
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] rptr_syn;
        
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                rptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_syn <= rptr_syn ^ rptr;
            end
        end
        // Read Pointer Logic
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] raddr;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] raddr_bin;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] rptr;
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] rptr_buff;
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr <= 0;
                raddr_bin <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                    raddr <= raddr + 1;
                    raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr <= {rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)], rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1], rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0]} ^ rptr;
            end
        end
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
